items.title: 21shares Announces 1-for-10 Reverse Share Split for 21Shares 2x Long Dogecoin ETF (TXXD)
items.summary: 21shares announced a 1-for-10 reverse share split for its 21Shares 2x Long Dogecoin ETF (TXXD), effective after market close on September 4, 2026. The split will reduce outstanding shares by approximately 90% while increasing per-share NAV and market price by a factor of ten. The adjustment is purely structural and does not affect shareholders' total investment value.

items.title: SK Hynix hits Nasdaq July 10. SKUU and SKDD are expected to launch on July 14.
Four days until GraniteShares SKUU and SKDD go live
items.summary: SK Hynix, the world's leading supplier of High Bandwidth Memory, is expected to begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker SKHY on July 10, 2026, marking the largest ADR listing in history. GraniteShares plans to launch a pair of 2x leveraged ETFs on July 13: SKUU (2x long) for bullish traders and SKDD (2x short) for bearish traders, allowing investors to capitalize on expected volatility from the new listing.
